films.desc_en: A sophisticated showcase of a custom-made modern kitchen bringing joy to a homeowner.
films.music: Warm, inspiring acoustic guitar and soft piano, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Сонувате за совршен простор во домот?
Време е да го претворите во реалност.
Секој детаљ создаден само за вас.

shots.kf: Woman in her 40s, short dark hair, wearing a white linen blouse, stands gracefully near a large window overlooking the scenic Mount Vodno in Skopje. The room is bathed in soft, warm morning light. Captured with a 50mm lens, cinematic composition, featuring a pastel and earthy color palette, highly detailed and photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman slowly turns her head towards the camera with a gentle smile as the camera slowly pushes in.

shots.kf: Close-up of smooth, premium oak wood grain being illuminated by warm, dappled sunlight streaming through a window. Dust motes float peacefully in the air. Shot with a macro lens, shallow depth of field, rich warm amber and brown tones, cinematic studio lighting, exceptionally photorealistic textures.
shots.motion: Sunlight slowly shifts across the wood surface, highlighting the grain, while the camera subtly pans right.

shots.kf: A stunning, modern minimalist kitchen interior featuring elegant matte beige cabinets and a thick, premium wooden island. The space is decorated with minimalist elements and filled with bright natural daylight. Wide 24mm lens, precise architectural composition, clean neutral color palette, highly photorealistic interior design.
shots.motion: A slow, smooth cinematic camera track forward towards the beautiful wooden kitchen island, highlighting the clean modern design.

shots.kf: Woman in her 40s, short dark hair, wearing a white linen blouse, stands confidently in the modern kitchen, her hand resting gently on the wooden island. Medium shot, 35mm lens, soft diffused indoor lighting, earthy and warm colors, highly photorealistic and cinematic.
shots.motion: The woman gently slides a hand across the smooth wooden surface as the camera slowly dollies left.

shots.kf: Woman in her 40s, short dark hair, wearing a white linen blouse, sitting comfortably on a high stool at the kitchen island, holding a beautiful ceramic coffee cup. Over-the-shoulder perspective, bright sunny morning illuminating the room, 50mm lens, warm and inviting colors, highly photorealistic and serene atmosphere.
shots.motion: Steam rises slowly from the coffee cup while the camera gently pulls back to reveal the beautiful kitchen.

films.desc_en: A majestic solid walnut dining table is crafted and perfectly placed in a modern dining room.
films.music: Deep, soulful cello with slow cinematic percussion, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Природата крие најубави форми и бои.
Ние им даваме нов, вечен живот.

shots.kf: Massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs sitting majestically in a rustic, sunlit woodworking studio in North Macedonia. Fine sawdust covers the floor beneath heavy wooden beams. Wide shot, 35mm lens, warm golden hour lighting, rich brown and amber color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance in the golden light as the camera slowly pushes in towards the majestic table.

shots.kf: Close-up of a thick slab of raw walnut wood on a workbench. A heavy steel hand plane rests on top, surrounded by elegant, curly wood shavings. Macro photography, 85mm lens, dramatic directional side lighting, deep amber and charcoal tones, highly photorealistic texture.
shots.motion: A single wood shaving gently flutters as if blown by a light breeze, camera slowly pans left.

shots.kf: Close-up of the massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs, its surface gleaming beautifully with fresh oil. Soft window light reflects elegantly off the polished, rich grain. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm tones, cinematic and highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The reflection of the window light moves smoothly across the oiled wood surface, camera tilts down slightly.

shots.kf: The massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs placed perfectly in a luxurious modern dining room in Skopje. Floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a stunning twilight cityscape. 24mm lens, architectural framing, cool blue and warm orange contrast, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow, elegant camera dolly from left to right, showcasing the table's perfect placement in the room.

shots.kf: The massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs, elegantly set with ceramic plates, folded linen napkins, and crystal wine glasses under a warm modern pendant light. 35mm lens, moody atmospheric lighting, sophisticated earthy color palette, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The pendant light swings almost imperceptibly while the camera slowly pushes in towards the table setting.

films.line_mk: Удобност која го трансформира вашиот дневен престој.
films.line_en: Comfort that transforms your living room.
films.desc_en: A fast-paced visual exploration of a luxurious velvet sofa set against stunning nature.
films.music: Upbeat, luxurious electronic lounge with heavy bass, 115 bpm
vo_mk: Удобност која го трансформира вашиот дневен престој.

shots.kf: Plump, luxurious emerald green velvet sofa centered in a modern minimalist photography studio. Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A heavy silk decorative cushion is suspended in mid-air just above the plush seat. 35mm lens, soft studio lighting, rich green and gold palette, incredibly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The cushion drops slowly onto the velvet sofa, creating a soft bounce, while the camera remains static.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of the plush emerald green velvet fabric of the luxurious sofa. Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Macro lens capturing individual fibers, dramatic directional lighting highlighting the soft texture, deep green tones with golden highlights, highly photorealistic and tactile, inviting the viewer to reach out and touch it.
shots.motion: A subtle ripple moves across the luxurious fabric as the lighting shifts, and the camera slowly dollies in.

shots.kf: The emerald green velvet sofa positioned perfectly in a stunning living room with a massive vertical window framing the dramatic rocky cliffs of Matka Canyon. Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. 24mm lens, natural daylight, contrasting deep green and cool grey stone colors, photorealistic interior.
shots.motion: Slow, smooth camera push-in towards the sofa against the magnificent canyon backdrop, emphasizing the grand scale.

films.line_mk: Плакар кој совршено се вклопува во вашиот стил.
films.line_en: A closet that perfectly fits into your style.
films.desc_en: A step-by-step visual explanation of how custom built-in wardrobes are designed, manufactured, and installed.
films.music: Clean, rhythmic corporate tech ambient with subtle marimba, 105 bpm
vo_mk: Процесот започнува со прецизно мерење на вашиот простор.
Користиме најмодерна технологија за обработка на материјалите.
Секој елемент се склопува со внимание и прецизност.
Плакар кој совршено се вклопува во вашиот стил.

shots.kf: An empty, immaculately clean bedroom corner featuring pristine white walls and light oak hardwood floors. Bright, fresh morning light enters gently from a side window. 24mm wide lens, perfect architectural composition, minimalist white and beige color palette, highly photorealistic blank canvas.
shots.motion: Slow camera pan across the empty corner, establishing the blank canvas of the bright, unfurnished room.

shots.kf: Close-up of a sleek digital tablet resting on a textured wooden desk, displaying a glowing, intricate 3D wireframe blueprint of a modern custom wardrobe. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, cool blue screen glow contrasting with warm wood, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The 3D blueprint slowly rotates on the tablet screen while the camera slowly pushes in for a closer look.

shots.kf: A high-tech automated CNC wood-cutting machine in a spotless modern workshop, hovering precisely over a large MDF panel. Clean industrial setting without human workers. 35mm lens, bright even fluorescent lighting, grey and subtle yellow color palette, highly photorealistic industrial scene.
shots.motion: The CNC machine head glides smoothly across the panel without human hands, while the camera remains perfectly static.

shots.kf: A perfectly neat stack of freshly cut, matte-finished wooden wardrobe panels resting securely on an industrial workshop cart. 50mm lens, soft diffused workshop lighting, neutral pastel and light wood color palette, highly photorealistic textures showcasing precision manufacturing and excellent craftsmanship in every detail.
shots.motion: Slow camera dolly from bottom to top, revealing the incredibly smooth edges of the perfectly stacked wooden panels.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of a premium metal sliding track mechanism for a modern wardrobe, securely mounted on a wooden frame. Macro lens, incredibly sharp focus, sleek metallic and warm wood tones, professional studio lighting, highly photorealistic showcasing top-tier engineering quality and flawless modern design.
shots.motion: The metal wheel glides slowly and smoothly along the track, as the camera perfectly follows the mechanical movement.

shots.kf: Tall, elegant sliding doors of a built-in custom wardrobe, featuring a flawless matte beige finish and sleek integrated handles. 35mm lens, soft and inviting indoor lighting, warm earthy and neutral tones, cinematic and highly photorealistic residential interior design that feels both premium and beautifully accessible.
shots.motion: One of the sliding doors slowly glides shut to meet the frame perfectly, while the camera remains static.

shots.kf: A beautifully finished, floor-to-ceiling modern built-in wardrobe seamlessly integrated into a luxurious, well-decorated bedroom. Wide 24mm lens, perfectly balanced architectural lighting, sophisticated neutral color palette with soft textures, highly photorealistic showcasing the ultimate custom home storage solution that transforms the entire living space beautifully.
shots.motion: Slow, majestic camera pull-back to reveal the full scale and breathtaking beauty of the finished built-in wardrobe.

films.line_mk: Вашиот нов почеток со нашиот врвен мебел.
films.line_en: Your new beginning with our premium furniture.
films.desc_en: Magical timelapse morphs showing bare, unfinished rooms turning into beautifully furnished modern spaces.
films.music: Uplifting orchestral swell with a magical, hopeful tone, 90 bpm
vo_mk: Од празен простор до топол дом полн со стил.
Вашиот нов почеток со нашиот врвен мебел.

shots.kf: Bare, unfurnished living room with exposed rough concrete walls and dusty floors. A large window shows a typical sunny Skopje neighborhood. Wide 24mm lens, flat grey lighting, cold and uninviting color palette, highly photorealistic construction site awaiting a complete interior transformation.
shots.end_kf: The exact same living room, now completely finished and featuring a plush white sectional sofa, a textured rug, and modern oak wall paneling. Wide 24mm lens, warm inviting sunlight, earthy and cozy color palette, highly photorealistic interior that looks perfectly ready for comfortable family living.
shots.motion: The room seamlessly morphs from the bare concrete state into the fully furnished, warm living room, camera completely static.

shots.kf: An empty kitchen space with rough, unfinished plaster walls, exposed plumbing pipes, and a bare concrete floor. 35mm lens, harsh and dramatic construction lighting, drab grey and brown color palette, highly photorealistic raw building environment before the beautiful custom cabinetry is finally installed.
shots.end_kf: The exact same kitchen space, now fully fitted with sleek navy-blue cabinetry, a glowing white marble countertop, and elegant brass fixtures. 35mm lens, soft elegant lighting, rich blue and gold color palette, highly photorealistic premium kitchen ready for a master chef to begin cooking.
shots.motion: The bare walls seamlessly transition into the luxurious navy and marble kitchen setup, while the camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: A desolate dining area with scuffed wooden floorboards and bare white walls, looking completely abandoned, cold, and empty. 35mm lens, overcast light coming gently through the window, muted and desaturated color palette, highly photorealistic unrenovated space in desperate need of new furniture and life.
shots.end_kf: The exact same dining area, now proudly featuring a grand solid wood dining table, stylish mid-century chairs, and a striking statement chandelier. 35mm lens, warm ambient evening light, rich wood and amber tones, highly photorealistic, creating a perfect atmosphere for a wonderful dinner party.
shots.motion: The cold, empty space beautifully transforms into a welcoming dining area, while the camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: An empty, lifeless bedroom with bare drywall, electrical wires hanging loosely from the ceiling, and no flooring installed yet. 24mm lens, stark industrial lighting, pale and uninviting color palette, highly photorealistic construction phase showing a completely blank canvas for future home design.
shots.end_kf: The exact same bedroom, now beautifully showcasing a luxurious upholstered bed, elegant wooden nightstands, and soft glowing bedside lamps. 24mm lens, cozy and romantic mood lighting, warm beige and soft grey tones, highly photorealistic peaceful oasis designed for ultimate relaxation and a perfect night's sleep.
shots.motion: The unfinished room magically morphs into a peaceful, luxurious bedroom oasis, while the camera remains completely static.
